_about: The recommended groups, in their tab order. Setup copies this to Outreach/segments.json and the user drops or adds groups there; build_page.py uses this file when segments.json is missing. Everyone Else is always last and never listed. Shapes: references/data-format.md.

groups.label: Recruiters

groups.label: HR / People
groups.rule: HR and People titles. Recruiters have their own group.

groups.label: Executives
